module_summary: Three-requester fixed-priority arbiter built as a 4-state Moore FSM (idle plus one grant state per device) with one-hot grants decoded from state.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Arbiter state register: idle A or granting device 0/1/2; decoded into g.

anchors.name: r
anchors.why: Three request lines; priority-resolved in idle, hold grant while asserted.

anchors.name: g
anchors.why: One-hot grant vector decoded from states B, C, D.

groups.name: priority_arbiter_fsm
groups.description: FSM with next-state priority logic r0>r1>r2 and state-decoded grants.
